## Rule (verified byte-equal over 200,268 ab pairs — 2026-06-11, worker-395)

Halves-NOR. Grids are fixed 6×3 active (top-left). Split the 6-row grid into a top
3×3 half [H 0:3] and bottom 3×3 half [H 3:6], both columns [W 0:3]. For each of the
3×3 cell positions:
- output **color 2** iff BOTH the top cell and the bottom cell are background
  (`ch0 == 1`, i.e. NEITHER is colored) — a per-cell NOR;
- else output **color 0** (background).

The 3×3 result is embedded top-left in the [1,10,30,30] canvas; the rest is padding
(Pad with 0 → decodes to "no color" 10). Selector vectors: `tgt_vec` = color-2 one-hot,
`bg_vec` = color-0 one-hot.

```
top = input[:,0:1, 0:3, 0:3]; bot = input[:,0:1, 3:6, 0:3]   # bg channel
out_cell = color2 if (top==1 and bot==1) else color0          # NOR
output   = pad(onehot(out_cell), end H/W = 27)                # [1,10,30,30]
```

## Sub-165 floor proof (worker-395b, 2026-06-22)

No correct sub-165 candidate found. Current floor remains the team-best BOOL tail:
`Team_Best_Onnx/task395.onnx`, SHA
`591fe66edc5027b4b5451d5af6d72e82fbd3ac2b9fc3a9143f04b2d9cea38b88`,
static/profile **165**. Refreshed gates: visible **268/268**, truth-full
**200000/200000**, AB-full **200268/200268 byte_equal=True**, profile_real_cost
`static=165 profile=165`.

Concrete probes:
- `task395_twochan_nozero.onnx`: static/profile **147** but visible **20/268 FAIL**.
  It concatenates `[occupied,hole]`; terminal `Pad` can only add channels at the
  front/end, so the hole mask lands in channel 1 instead of color-2 channel 2.
  The channel-1 zero spacer is load-bearing. This is scoped to the current
  `[occupied, zero, hole]` tail: `Pad` cannot insert a missing middle channel.
- `task395_conv_direct.onnx`: visible **268/268 PASS**, static/profile **410**.
  Rejected on cost only; not used as a full-gated correctness proof for the
  no-slice class.
- `task395_einsum_freeoutput.onnx`: #109/#119 free-output route, visible
  **268/268 PASS**, static/profile **270**, SHA
  `ad96397b309cb93f167a2a6faf135f44eef15f739333a71630ed095f13638876`.
  It proves the product can live inside one terminal `Einsum`, but the selectors
  lose to 165.

Best #109/#119 formulation tested: two-term window-minus-product, not 9 per-cell terms.

| term | source expression | output route |
|---|---|---|
| inside | `(top ch0 + top ch9) * (bottom ch0 + bottom ch1)` | `+ch0` |
| `P` | `top ch0 * bottom ch0` | `-ch0 + ch2` |

Charged factors for `Einsum('nchw,nduw,tc,td,tk,sh,su,sr,w->nkrw')`:

| factor | shape | elements | role |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `top_chan` | `[2,10]` | 20 | active-vs-bg top selector |
| `bot_chan` | `[2,10]` | 20 | active-vs-bg bottom selector |
| `out_chan` | `[2,10]` | 20 | `+ch0` and `-ch0/+ch2` routing |
| `row_top_out` | `[3,30]` | 90 | shared top-source/output row slots |
| `row_bot` | `[3,30]` | 90 | bottom rows 3:6 paired to output rows 0:3 |
| `col` | `[30]` | 30 | shared top/bottom/output col gate 0:3 |
| **total** |  | **270** | memory 0, params 270 |

The `P = top_bg * bottom_bg` idea does work in-kernel from repeated input operands:
no materialized slices and no 9-cell product plane. It still cannot price below
165 because the bottom-row-to-output-row coupling has rank 3. The minimum slot
coupling needs `row_top_out[3,30]` + `row_bot[3,30]` + `col[30]` = 210 elements
before any channel routing; the two-term inside/product channel selectors add at
least 60 more. A positive four-combination selector avoids negative weights but
raises the channel factors to 120, for **330**. A dense shift matrix is worse
(`30*30=900`).

#154 row-packed bitwise lane lower bound with full adapter:

| component | minimum charged tensor(s) | bytes |
|---|---|---:|
| F32 source read | two `[1,1,3,3]` slices | 72 |
| cast for bitwise | two U32 `[1,1,3,3]` planes | 72 |
| pack rows | top/bottom U32 `[1,1,3,1]` | 24 |
| bitwise body | one U32 row lane for NOR/AND result | 12 |
| unpack bits | at least one U32 `[1,1,3,3]` plane | 36 |
| hole bool | `[1,1,3,3]` | 9 |
| ch0 completion | occupied bool + zero spacer | 18 |
| final small tail | `small BOOL [1,3,3,3]` before `Pad` | 27 |
| **lower bound** | excludes pack masks/shifts and Slice params | **270** |

So #154 loses before implementation. The current BOOL graph already computes the
3x3 logic in five 9-byte BOOL planes; packing cannot repay the F32 read/cast,
unpack, and paint/ch0 completion adapter. Also, `core.md` requires `ch0=1` inside
active background cells; a hole-only or all-zero active background shortcut is not
a valid output encoding.

Slice-family floor at 165: the two F32 source slices (72), two Casts (18),
`occupied`/`hole` (18), channel-1 zero spacer (9), `small[1,3,3,3]` (27), and
21 params are required unless the channel layout or full-output renderer changes.
The only concrete sub-165 channel-layout deletion is visibly wrong; the tested
full-output renderers are 270 and 410.
